test_title: PYST 11: SSC JE EE- General Awareness (Held on: 15 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: In 2022, which state government launched the "Naan Mudhalvan Scheme" which aims to equip about 10 lakh youth across the State annually with skills that will help them realise their talents for the benefit of the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu launched the** ‘Naan Mudhalvan’ scheme.**
 
• The scheme aims to provide skills to the** 10-lakh youth across the state.**
 
• The youths will be able to recognize their talents and interests through this scheme.</
